record.edic_text:
2940 kubeia {koo-bi'-ah}

from kubos (a "cube", i.e. die for playing);; n f

AV - sleight 1; 1

1) dice playing
2) metaph. the deception of men, because dice players sometimes
   cheated and defrauded their fellow players
